name: ghostgrid-monorepo
description: GhostGrid: infrastructure dependency explorer with Graph-Git version control, what-if failure simulation and graph feature extraction.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend && npm run test:py -w backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
